# Deploy SOLO app shell — DEV
# Tokens infra: servicesname, namespace, ambiente, tag, containerregistries,
#   host, tlsecret, gatewayhost, gatewayhostip, reqcpu, reqmem, limcpu, limmem


---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-secret
  namespace: #{namespace}#
type: Opaque
stringData:
  NG_APP_HEADERS_API_KEY: "${REDACTED_REAL_VALUE_SEE_LIVE_BUILD_579}"
  NG_APP_BASE_SECRET_KEY: "${REDACTED_REAL_VALUE_SEE_LIVE_BUILD_579}"
  NG_APP_BASE_IV_ENCRYPT: "${REDACTED_REAL_VALUE_SEE_LIVE_BUILD_579}"

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-config
  namespace: #{namespace}#
data:
  NG_APP_SYSTEM_UIID: "BA8232B9-7432-45DD-A0CB-37CD8BC18817"
  NG_APP_MENU_SYSTEM_UIID: "BA8232B9-7432-45DD-A0CB-37CD8BC18817"
  NG_APP_SYSTEM_TYPE_INTERNAL: "true"
  NG_APP_SYSTEM_TYPE_EXTERNAL: "false"
  NG_APP_SYSTEM_TYPE_CORE: "false"

  NG_APP_HEADERS_CONTENT_TYPE: "application/json"
  NG_APP_HEADERS_ORIGIN: "*"

  NG_APP_BASE_URL_GATEWAY: "https://microservice-gateway-api-dev.gmontecristo.com/api/v1"
  NG_APP_URL_PORTAL: "https://shell-web-dev.gmontecristo.com"
  NG_APP_URL_HR: "https://hr-web-dev.gmontecristo.com"
  NG_APP_URL_ONTOLOGY: "https://ontology-web-dev.gmontecristo.com"
  NG_APP_URL_TICKETING: "https://ticketing-web-dev.gmontecristo.com"
  NG_APP_COOKIE_DOMAIN: ".gmontecristo.com"

  NG_APP_MSAL_AUTH_CLIENT_ID: "8792fa69-3b21-481a-8492-89c15c023d3a"
  NG_APP_MSAL_AUTH_TENANT_ID: "33dd4184-3068-47da-891d-a70e02f8c0c9"
  NG_APP_MSAL_AUTH_AUTHORITY: "https://login.microsoftonline.com/33dd4184-3068-47da-891d-a70e02f8c0c9"
  NG_APP_MSAL_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI: "https://shell-web-dev.gmontecristo.com/autologin"
  NG_APP_MSAL_AUTH_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI: "https://shell-web-dev.gmontecristo.com/signin"
  NG_APP_MSAL_CONFIG_SCOPES: "User.Read"
  NG_APP_MSAL_CONFIG_URI: "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me"
  NG_APP_MSAL_CONFIG_PROFILE: "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me"
  NG_APP_MSAL_CONFIG_PROFILE_PHOTO: "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/photo/$value"

  NG_APP_TEST_USERS_ENABLED: "true"

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
    version: "#{tag}#"
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: #{servicesname}#
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: #{servicesname}#
        version: "#{tag}#"
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: acr-pull-secret
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: false
        runAsUser: 0
        runAsGroup: 0
        fsGroup: 0
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: nginx-cache
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 100Mi
        - name: app-logs
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 50Mi
      containers:
        - name: #{servicesname}#
          image: "#{containerregistries}#/#{servicesname}##{ambiente}#:#{tag}#"
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-config
            - secretRef:
                name: #{servicesname}#-secret
          env:
            - name: TZ
              value: "America/Costa_Rica"
            - name: NODE_ENV
              value: "production"
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            - name: nginx-cache
              mountPath: /var/cache/nginx
            - name: app-logs
              mountPath: /var/log/nginx
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "#{reqcpu}#m"
              memory: "#{reqmem}#Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "#{limcpu}#m"
              memory: "#{limmem}#Mi"
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
              scheme: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
              scheme: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
              scheme: HTTP
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 30
            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          lifecycle:
            preStop:
              exec:
                command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 15"]

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  labels:
    app: #{servicesname}#
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: #{servicesname}#
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080

---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-ingress
  namespace: #{namespace}#
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: "HTTP"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "300m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffering: "on"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-connect-timeout: "30"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "240"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "240"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-connections: "32"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-timeout: "60s"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/upstream-keepalive-requests: "100"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffer-size: "16k"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-buffers-number: "8"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/affinity: "cookie"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/affinity-mode: "persistent"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-name: "route"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-path: "/"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-max-age: "86400"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream: "error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream-tries: "3"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - shell-web-dev.gmontecristo.com
      secretName: gmontecristo-secret
  rules:
    - host: shell-web-dev.gmontecristo.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: #{servicesname}#
                port:
                  number: 80

---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-hpa
  namespace: #{namespace}#
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: #{servicesname}#
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 1
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 80
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
      selectPolicy: Max
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 100
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      selectPolicy: Max
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 50
          periodSeconds: 60

    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/session-cookie-max-age: "86400"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream: "error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-next-upstream-tries: "3"
spec:
  ingressClassName: internal-ingress
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - shell-web.buklo.dev
      secretName: buklo-dev-cert-secret
  rules:
    - host: shell-web.buklo.dev
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: #{servicesname}#
                port:
                  number: 80

---
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: #{servicesname}#-hpa
  namespace: #{namespace}#
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: #{servicesname}#
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 1
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: memory
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 80
  behavior:
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
      selectPolicy: Max
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 100
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      selectPolicy: Max
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 50
          periodSeconds: 60
